title: Smart photographic bird nook identifies 11,000 species
caption:
This smart feeder identifies 11,000 species and sends notifications straight to your phone. It even tracks individual visitors in your own backyard.

Source: Newatlas - Smart photographic bird nook identifies 11,000 species

https://newatlas.com/around-the-home/nook-smart-bird-feeder/
